props.title: Use ShowAI in ChatGPT on the web
props.lead: Connect the official MCP server to find projects, create interactive pages, save them to ShowAI Cloud, and continue editing in ChatGPT. Each person adds their own connection and signs in to their own ShowAI account.

content.text: ChatGPT on the web connects through a ShowAI Cloud account, and registration currently needs a registration key from the operator or an invitation to a shared project. Without one, you can use ShowAI in

Use a ChatGPT account that can add custom MCP servers. Workspace permissions and security restrictions can hide this option; if you cannot find Add custom MCP server, check account availability and administrator settings. Once your ShowAI account is set up, everyday web use requires no local ShowAI process, ZIP installation, or separate Skills.

If you already have a ShowAI Cloud account, continue to step 2. Your ChatGPT and ShowAI accounts are separate. GitHub or Google sign-in must already be linked to your ShowAI account. Official Cloud registration is controlled; adding the MCP connection does not create an account.

steps.title: Get an invitation or registration key
steps.body: Ask the administrator of a shared project for an invitation link, or ask the ShowAI Cloud operator for a registration key. Until you have one, you can use public components, templates, and temporary rendering. Saving private projects requires an account.

steps.title: Complete initial registration in the workbench
steps.body: For now, first-time setup uses the ShowAI workbench (desktop app or local browser edition). With a registration key: in Settings → Account & sync → Server accounts → Add server account, enter the Cloud address below, choose Create account, and enter an account name, a password of at least 12 characters and the registration key. With an invitation: paste the invitation link into Project sync → Join a shared project, then register and confirm joining in the invitation card; this route needs no registration key.

steps.title: Keep your sign-in method ready
steps.body: Keep your account name and password ready for the MCP authorization page. To use GitHub or Google instead, open Account and devices on the workbench account card and link that identity first.

2. Add the MCP server in ChatGPT
Open chatgpt.com/plugins using the link below, select the plus button, then Add custom MCP server.
Enter the settings below. Choose a server URL connection; no local launch command or tunnel is needed.
Review the notice, confirm you want to continue, select Create as a plugin, and install the ShowAI plugin you just created. Complete step 3 when connecting or first accessing a project.
Choose Dynamic Client Registration (DCR) if prompted
Leave blank; DCR registers the client automatically. No OpenAI API key is needed

The MCP address ends in /mcp; the account and workbench sync address ends in /cloud. Use the former as ChatGPT's Server URL. Public tools allow anonymous calls; personal project access triggers OAuth sign-in.

steps.title: Sign in to your own ShowAI account
steps.body: On the Connect ShowAI page, confirm the server is official Cloud and enter your existing account name and password, or choose a linked GitHub or Google identity. These are your ShowAI sign-in credentials, not your ChatGPT password.

steps.title: For social sign-in: enter the completion code
steps.body: Select Open login page and finish GitHub or Google sign-in in the new tab. The final page shows an 8-character completion code, such as XXXX-XXXX. Return to the original Connect ShowAI tab, enter it in Completion code, and select Continue. Enter the code only on that authorization page, not in chat. Password sign-in skips this step.

steps.title: Confirm project scope and permissions
steps.body: For one existing project, choose Only authorize one project. To create projects, choose all projects this account can access now and in the future, and check that consent includes project creation as well as reading and editing. Verify the account and permissions, confirm authorization, and return to ChatGPT. Account-wide access still respects each project's member permissions; viewers cannot edit.

content.text: With a single-project grant, other projects and new projects are not automatically included. Reconnect and authorize again in ChatGPT to expand access. Sign in again when the connection expires, is revoked, or its permissions change.
4. Create and save your first page

Start a new regular ChatGPT web chat, type @, and select the ShowAI connection you installed. Keep using the same connection; if several have similar names, verify the MCP address. Send these three requests in order.

steps.title: Check the connection and projects
steps.body:
Check your identity, access scope, and visible projects first. A new account can have an empty project list.

Use ShowAI to check my current connection and list the projects I can access.

steps.title: Create, save, and present
steps.body:
Requires account-wide access and project creation permission. Review write actions when ChatGPT prompts you. When finished, check the returned project, page, and sync status.

Use ShowAI to create a project called My Interactive Notes. Make a page explaining opportunity cost with an interactive example whose choices I can change. Save it in that project, confirm sync status, and present it in this chat.

steps.title: Continue editing the saved page
steps.body:
Identify the project and page you just created so the agent can read it before editing. In a new chat, find it by project and page name.

Use ShowAI to open the opportunity cost page in My Interactive Notes, add an everyday example, keep the existing interaction, save, and present the update.

content.text: MCP supplies workflows, component documentation, and template guides on demand from shared Skill source files. ChatGPT needs no local Skill installation. Check presentation, saving, and sync separately: seeing a preview does not prove sync succeeded. Projects stored only on your computer must first be synced through the workbench to the same Cloud account before web ChatGPT can find them.
Workflow guidance, template instructions, or server implementation
ShowAI maintainers deploy these updates. Later requests use the deployed version. Start a new chat to load current guidance; no ZIP download is needed.
Tool names, descriptions, parameters, auth metadata, or preview resources
Open ChatGPT Plugins → your ShowAI connection → Refresh. Check the tool list, then start a new chat and select @ShowAI again.
Expired sign-in or broader access needed
Reconnect, sign in, and confirm access as prompted. Refreshing tools does not expand project permissions.

Share this guide and the official MCP address with others. Each person adds a connection in their own ChatGPT account and authorizes their own ShowAI account. Your private connection and permissions are not shared through the link.

attrs.title: OAuth discovery fails, or DCR is unavailable

content.text: Check that the full Server URL includes /mcp and select Retry metadata discovery in Advanced OAuth settings. If it still fails, enter the OAuth endpoints below manually, then set Registration method to Dynamic Client Registration (DCR). Leave the client ID and secret blank, and keep OIDC off.

For default requested scopes, enter projects.read, projects.write, and projects.create as needed, one per line; read-only use can keep only projects.read. Final access depends on consent and project roles. If creation or sign-in still fails, keep the error details and contact the maintainer.

attrs.title: No account, or GitHub / Google sign-in fails

content.text: Get an invitation or registration key and create a Cloud account as described in step 1. If your social identity is not linked, use your account name and password, then link it in the workbench later. Return the completion code to the tab that started sign-in; restart sign-in if it expires.

attrs.title: Cannot find or create a project

content.text: Check the Cloud account, whether the project is synced, and whether you granted only one project. Creating a project requires account-wide access and creation permission. If consent did not include project creation, request a new project and follow the reauthorization prompt. If a tool is missing, refresh tools, start a new chat, and verify the selected connection URL.

Try Retry on the preview card first. If it still fails, ask ChatGPT to report the page's save and sync state and provide the complete HTML deliverable if available. Diagnose preview and save failures separately, and keep the error details for a report.
